Accounting (ACCT)

Program Overview

The department offers graduate study in accounting for students entering the profession and for those continuing towards research. Each programme below admits once a year, in the autumn term.

Requirements for the M.Acc. in Accounting

ACCT 50103Financial Reporting3
ACCT 50203Assurance Services3
ACCT 50303Taxation of Entities3

Requirements for the Ph.D. in Business Administration (Accounting)

Candidates complete a first and second year research project and then sit the candidacy examination before writing the dissertation.
